IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [FieldTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [HideHeader] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_HideHeader] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [HideFooter] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_HideFooter] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_FieldType] FOREIGN KEY([FieldTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FieldType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_FieldType] END
